name: Khazarad, Corner of Mine Street and Forge Street
desc1: This broad, flagstone-lined street angles sharply in the northeastern
desc2: corner of the dwarven city. The cave wall to the north and east has
desc3: been worn flat, smoothed, and engraved with intricate, angular
desc4: designs. A large wooden doorway is set in the eastern wall, a sign
desc5: posted over it displaying the figure of a mine cart prominently.
desc6: Forge Street heads off to the west here, while Mine Street continues
